fields.description: Castleton is an apartment phase at Central Park, City Walk. One- to four-bedroom homes are complemented by duplex penthouse layouts with separate living and sleeping levels. The shared park and recreation spaces provide an outdoor setting within the established urban district.

overview: The reviewed three-bedroom unit has almost as much outdoor balcony area as internal suite area. Buyers comparing it with a smaller plan should separate those measures instead of equating total area with enclosed rooms.
research.locationNote: At Central Park within City Walk, Dubai. Its phase brochure places Castleton within the landscaped neighbourhood; facilities are shared and individual outlooks depend on unit position.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains an approximately AED 2.1m launch reference. A current official project-wide quote was not found. Do not treat that historical figure as evidence of developer inventory or a specific resale price.
research.paymentNote: The official original sheet specifies 20% booking, 10% December 2022, 10% June 2023, 10% March 2024 and 50% March 2026 on handover. These dates have passed; remaining obligations must be established from the actual contract and paid instalments.
research.handoverNote: The original developer sheet and Property Finder name March 2026. Meraas lists Castleton sold out and still describes inspections and handover preparations. Actual unit delivery is therefore unconfirmed rather than inferred from the elapsed target.
